Money.description: Exact monetary value; JSON serializes the amount as a decimal string.

amount.description: Monetary amount in the associated currency, preserving source precision and sign.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: ISO three-letter currency code for the monetary amount.
currency.title: Currency

Money.title: Money

canonical_schema.description: Authority's stated arrears result without a mandatory duplicate transcription.

document_type.description: Identifies a tax-authority arrears or clearance certificate, distinct from a tax return.
document_type.title: Document type

taxpayer_name.description: Taxpayer's complete name exactly as printed on the certificate.
taxpayer_name.title: Taxpayer name

tax_identifier.description: Taxpayer identifier as printed, preserving leading zeros and formatting.
tax_identifier.title: Tax identifier

issuing_authority.description: Tax authority explicitly identified as issuing the certificate.
issuing_authority.title: Issuing authority

certificate_number.description: Authority-issued certificate reference exactly as printed, if present.
certificate_number.title: Certificate number

issue_date.description: Date the tax authority issued the certificate, as YYYY-MM-DD.
issue_date.title: Issue date

as_of_date.description: Date to which the arrears statement applies, if separately printed.
as_of_date.title: Statement date

arrears_statement.description: Meaning explicitly stated by the authority; not_stated means no interpretable claim, not zero debt or clearance.
arrears_statement.title: Authority's arrears statement

statement_as_printed.description: Verbatim wording when transcribed; optional alongside the happy case's normalized arrears statement. Supporting original source and review remain separate requirements.
statement_as_printed.title: Statement as printed

arrears_amount.description: Amount and currency explicitly printed; null is unknown, never inferred as zero from a clearance statement.
arrears_amount.title: Reported arrears amount
